question: What parts of the petal base must be extended in the design?
premises: The petal base has a measurable strength or thickness.
Half of that base strength is specified as a measure.
The root support is also subject to extension.
inference: One should extend both half the petal-root strength and the root support.
uncertainties: The precise architectural meaning of balārdhaṃ is not fully explicit.
plain_english: One should extend half the strength at the petal base and also extend the root support.
